column5: make_env()/load_config() default to saclb_campaign_v2.yaml with ClosedLoopKpmSource, backlog_capacity=200, MEAN_OFFERED_RATIO -- reused by ~15 existing scripts across M1-M7 history, not a new simulator

run_mc()'s own internal seed arithmetic (seed=base_seed+rep) does NOT match the real campaign's batch_seed=args.seed*1000+batch_idx (confirmed via saclb_xapp.py:93,98-99). Wrote a direct run_single() loop with the correct formula instead of using run_mc().

finding_summary: Replays the submitted DQN-QoE checkpoint (byte-identical, git tag m43-p1-submission-record) against all 28 submitted seeds (950-977), batch_seed=seed*1000+0, 2 episodes each, extracts per-step ceilings, classifies FLOOR-PINNED/CAP-RIDING/MIXED per M41's raw-PRB conversion
embb CAP-RIDING (10.8% below floor), urllc FLOOR-PINNED (100%), mmtc FLOOR-PINNED (100%) -- sane, ran full 28-seed sweep next

urllc: 28/28 seeds FLOOR-PINNED (100% of steps each, zero exceptions). mmtc: 28/28 seeds FLOOR-PINNED (100% of steps each, zero exceptions). embb: 0/28 FLOOR-PINNED, 24 CAP-RIDING + 4 MIXED, range 4.2%-24.2% steps below floor.

28/28 (100%) of actual submitted seeds have urllc+mmtc floor-pinned for their ENTIRE configured range (cap alone never reaches 5 raw PRB for either slice, per M42's own static audit) -- deterministic, not seed-dependent, for these two slices. Reconciles P1-vs-M42 apparent disagreement: pinned-at-floor (P1's seed 43003) and ridden-to-cap (M42's seed-961 sample) are equally broken (both <5 raw PRB). embb is the only slice with real seed variance (never floor-pins itself). Recommend P1B-2 use seed 961 (lowest embb exposure, 4.2%) and seed 960 (highest, 24.2%) as the genuinely distinguishing pair, since urllc/mmtc's own prediction is uniform across all seeds. Awaiting go before P1B-2 live test.
